selection_conflict.calculator: Tier 1 simplified/IPCC default; Tier 2 country-specific; Tier 3 direct measurement
selection_conflict.checklist_q23: Selection cells label Tier 1 direct measurement and Tier 3 default IPCC values, while later checklist section headings identify Tier 1 IPCC and Tier 3 direct measurement.

TIER_1_SIMPLIFIED.notes: Scenario 1 illustrates two crops, 1000ha year 1, +3000ha year 2; figures do not approve a result. Workbook GWP CH4=28 is AR5 training input not universal current rule.

TIER_2_COUNTRY_SPECIFIC.notes: Scenario 2 says 12000ha and 1.05 kg CH4/ha/day national EF, 10% illustrative uncertainty; must incorporate other GHG and loss terms per applicable method.

TIER_3_DIRECT.notes: Scenario 3 says 10000ha, baseline 420 and project 95 kg CH4/ha/year, 10% illustrative uncertainty; workbook E11=500/E22=120 are unrelated editable example values.

common_workbook_refs.limitation: A simple /12 monthly allocation is a workbook exercise and must not replace calendar-accurate vintage accounting without separate validation.

VERRA_VM0051_V1_1_2026.applicability: Section 4 (pp.9-10); baseline historical look-back >=3 years (pp.8,12); irrigated rice fields with controlled irrigation/drainage
VERRA_VM0051_V1_1_2026.global_principle: Baseline and project must use the same approach for the same GHG source within the monitoring period (p.18).

QA2_DIRECT_CHAMBER.critical: EC/HREA half-hourly site observations do not automatically meet VM0051 QA2 chamber sampling and controlled baseline plot design.

QA3_DEFAULT_EF.reference: Sec.8.1 pp.20-21 and default equations in Sec.8.2/8.3

VERRA_VM0051_V1_1_2026.dMRV: Appendix 4 pp.85-87 requires verifiable RS/AI evidence, independent ground truth and documented changes; no automatic VVB approval.

explicit_non_equivalences: GS TRAINING Tier1 default != Verra QA1 modeling
GS TRAINING Tier2 country EF != Verra QA2 flux chambers
GS TRAINING Tier3 measured != Verra QA3 default EF
Gold Standard Q23 text conflicts with the same document's later Tier section headings and workbook; Q23 must be human clarified
Verra QA2 chamber-control designs != archived JapanFlux JP-Hrt 30-minute Eddy Covariance FCH4 rows
Neither GS/Verra rules should be silently applied as Japanese J-Credit AG-005 effective rules
